notes:
Quick inbound SMB lead — self-serve signup last week; early discovery on hosted API + retention.

Summary: Sandbar Sentience builds a lightweight AI chat + FAQ plugin for small-to-mid e-commerce sites (embedded widget). They signed up via the website trial (dev keys) and used ~1k tokens interacting with the hosted API. Primary concerns are around data privacy and prompt storage: marketing/legal/ops want clarity on what Redwood stores, for how long, and how to opt customers out.

Key requirements: 
- Workload: low-volume chat + doc search; peak throughput modest (10-20 qps burst), avg monthly tokens ~50k initially.
- Latency target: median <500ms for chat responses.
- Cost sensitivity: SMB price-conscious; likely keep usage under $1k/mo in first 3 months.
- Model preference: open models ok (smaller family), but want deterministic fallback policy.
- Routing/fallback: want automatic fallback to cheaper variant if primary unavailable.
- Deployment: will use public cloud (AWS us-east-1). No VPC at this stage.

Retention/privacy asks (core):
- Default log retention window? They asked: "Do you keep prompts and responses for 30 days? We need maximum 7 days."
- Opt-out flag: need an opt-out/"do-not-log" per request header to ensure queries are not persisted for analytics.
- Deletion API: programmatic delete of stored prompts for a given customer or conversation (RPO SLA).
- Aggregation/anonymization: prefer token hashing or PII redaction for analytics if retention >7 days.
- Data residency: currently fine with US-only, may need EU residency later.
- Encryption: at-rest encryption + KMS integration preferred but not blocking for immediate POC.

Timeline / activities: 
- 2026-03-01: trial signup via website (dev keys created).
- 2026-03-05: discovery call (Jordan + Maya) w/ CTO (A. Rivera) and Head of Ops. Recorded — Fireflies ffid_20260305_01.
  - CTO quote: "We can't have full customer prompts available for 30 days — legal wants 7 days max or per-request opt-out."
  - Ops: asked for sample retention policy and deletion workflow.
- 2026-03-10: follow-up email with high-level retention options and link to public security FAQ (sent). Gmail thread: thread:1654321.
- 2026-03-12: Security team email: asked for explicit confirmation on whether hosted API logs are used for model training and where prompt logs are stored. Created support ticket RWD-1129.

Open items / blockers: 
- Need an official short retention policy doc they can include in privacy page.
- Want a confirmation that hosted API logs are not used for training models OR an opt-out mechanism.
- They need a documented deletion API and expected time-to-delete (hours/days).

Win criteria for Sandbar: 
- Clear documentation + a short sample policy they can paste on site.
- Simple per-request opt-out or retention TTL <=7 days for their account.
- Proof point: SOC2 + KMS support on roadmap / docs for encryption.

Next steps (assigned): 
- Jordan: send tailored retention FAQ + two short policy templates (7-day and 30-day) by 2026-03-13.
- Maya (SE): prepare a short demo showing how to set a header to skip logging; include sample curl and SDK snippets.
- Schedule 30-min follow up call with CTO A. Rivera on 2026-03-16 to walk retention options and deletion API SLA.

Internal notes: likely to convert if we can show simple retention controls and deletion API. SMB price sensitivity — keep hosted API pricing and clear docs front-and-center.

Attachments / links: drive:/redwood/proposals/sandbar-retention-deck.pdf (proposal + sample policy).
